title: Converting a Foreign Driving License in Türkiye: Steps & Validity
seoTitle: Converting a Foreign Driving License in Türkiye (2026)
metaDescription: Learn the 6-month foreign driving license limit in Türkiye, required Nüfus Müdürlüğü documents, bilateral exam exemptions, and card delivery times.
quickAnswer: Foreign nationals can legally drive in Türkiye on a valid foreign license for up to 6 months from their date of entry. After 6 months, residents must convert it into a Turkish driving license at a local [Nüfus Müdürlüğü](https://www.nvi.gov.tr/surucu-belgeleri) using a health report, notarized translations, and proof of education, usually without retaking a driving test.

Independent of provider commissions.")—we help visiting and relocating clients organize their orientation schedules on the ground. Important boundary: Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates visits, scheduling, and independent introductions only; licensing filings, notarizations, sworn translations, and legal representations belong strictly to licensed Turkish attorneys, notaries, and official authorities.
How long can you drive on your foreign license (6 months) before conversion is required?

Foreign citizens may drive in Türkiye with a valid foreign driving license for a maximum of 6 months starting from the date of entry stamped in their passport. Continuing to drive on an unconverted foreign license beyond 6 months violates Turkish road traffic regulations and can void insurance coverage after an accident.

If your foreign license is not printed in the Latin alphabet—or lacks standard international category codes—you must carry a notarized Turkish translation or an International Driving Permit (IDP) during that initial 6-month window. Once you hold a valid Turkish residence permit (ikamet) and plan to remain longer than six months, scheduling your conversion early prevents any gap in legal driving status. For seasonal driving context, especially on regional mountain and Anatolian routes, see our [Türkiye winter travel guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide).
Which documents (health report, notarized translation, diploma) are needed at Nüfus Müdürlüğü?

According to the [General Directorate of Population and Citizenship Affairs (NVI) Driving License FAQ](https://www.nvi.gov.tr/sss-surucu-belgeleri-hizmetleri) and [provincial Nüfus Müdürlüğü requirements](https://nvi.gov.tr/konya/surucubelgesi), applicants converting a foreign license must bring the original foreign card, a color photocopy, a notarized Turkish translation, a Turkish driver health report, a translated diploma, one biometric photo, and bank fee receipts.

Appointments are booked online via the [e-Devlet driving license appointment portal](https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/nvi-surucu-belgesi-basvuru-randevusu), the NVI web portal, or the Alo 199 call center. Fee schedules—covering the valuable paper fee, license tax, and foundation share—are updated annually, as published in the [NVI 2026 Application Fee Schedule](https://www.nvi.gov.tr/samsun/2026-yili-basvuru-ucretleri).

body.text: Do you have to retake a driving test?

In most cases, no driving test is required if your license was issued by a country party to the Vienna Convention on Road Traffic or a country holding a reciprocal agreement listed on the [NVI Bilateral Recognition Agreements page](https://www.nvi.gov.tr/surucu-belgelerinin-karsilikli). You only retake exams if your issuing country is ineligible for direct exchange or your card cannot be verified.

During the conversion process, Nüfus Müdürlüğü sends a verification request—often via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the issuing country's consulate—to confirm the authenticity of your original license. If the issuing authority does not confirm validity, or if your license comes from a jurisdiction outside mutual recognition frameworks, you must enroll in a licensed Turkish driving school (Sürücü Kursu) and pass both the theory and practical road exams.
How long does the Turkish card take to arrive?

After Nüfus Müdürlüğü confirms authenticity with your home country's issuing authority and finalizes your application, the biometric Turkish driving license card is printed in Ankara and delivered via PTT courier, typically within 1 to 2 weeks of final approval. However, the inter-consular verification stage itself can take anywhere from two weeks to several months depending on your home country.

Once your application is officially approved at the counter, Nüfus Müdürlüğü issues a temporary driving document (Geçici Sürücü Belgesi) valid for 15 days so you can drive legally in Türkiye while waiting for the physical card to arrive at your registered address.

items: Confirm your 99-series Foreigner ID (YKN) and registered residential address (adres kaydı) are active in the NVI system.
Obtain a Sürücü Olur medical report from an authorized Turkish doctor or private hospital.
Have your foreign driving license and highest diploma translated by a sworn translator and notarized in Türkiye.
Pay the 2026 license tax, valuable paper fee, and foundation share via a contracted Turkish bank.
Book your slot via Alo 199 or e-Devlet and bring all originals and receipts to your district Nüfus Müdürlüğü.

faq.q: Do I get my original foreign driving license back after conversion?
faq.a: In standard Turkish conversion procedures, Nüfus Müdürlüğü retains the physical foreign driving license and returns it to the issuing country's authorities once the Turkish license is issued.

faq.q: Can I convert my foreign license on a tourist visa without a residence permit?
faq.a: No. Direct foreign license conversion at Nüfus Müdürlüğü requires a valid Turkish residence permit (ikamet) and an active Foreigner ID number (YKN).

faq.q: Does leaving Türkiye for a weekend reset the 6-month driving clock?
faq.a: Relying on brief border runs to reset driving privileges is risky for residents living full-time in Türkiye. If you hold a residence permit and reside in Türkiye, converting your license before the 6-month mark is the compliant path.

faq.q: Is an apostille required on my university diploma for license conversion?
faq.a: Most district Nüfus offices accept a sworn Turkish translation notarized in Türkiye without a separate Ministry of Education equivalency (denklik), though specific offices occasionally ask for apostilled originals—confirm locally before your appointment.

faq.q: How long is a converted Turkish Class B driving license valid?
faq.a: Standard Class B passenger-car driving licenses issued in Türkiye are valid for 10 years before renewal, whereas heavy-vehicle and commercial classes carry a 5-year validity period.

faq.q: Can I drive outside Türkiye with my new Turkish driving license?
faq.a: Yes. Türkiye's modern biometric driving license follows international Vienna Convention formatting and is widely accepted for short-term driving abroad, though some destinations still require an accompanying IDP.
